title: Tax Helper
toastPickPeriod: Pick a fiscal period using the calendar in the top bar first.
toastPackStarted: Download started — send this file to your accountant.
selectPeriod: Select a fiscal period from the calendar in the top bar to see this report.

hub.intro: A simple step-by-step guide — no accounting degree needed. We pull numbers from your sales and purchases, you add anything missing, then download a pack for your accountant.
hub.step1Body: Use the calendar button in the top bar to pick the fiscal year or period you are preparing for.
hub.step2Title: Add anything Custoray might be missing
hub.step2Body: Bank fees, equipment, loans, or side income — add them here and we include them in your reports.
hub.step3Body: A quick summary, then open each report for the full plain-language breakdown.
hub.step3Empty: Pick a fiscal period from the top bar calendar to see summaries and reports.
hub.moneyInHint: Sales plus any extra income you added
hub.moneyOutHint: Purchases plus any extra expenses you added
hub.netWorthHint: What you have minus what you owe
hub.plHint: See what came in from sales and what went out on purchases — like a simple income statement.
hub.bsHint: A snapshot of customer balances, inventory, and bills — what the business has and owes today.
hub.ysHint: Counts, monthly trends, and your biggest customers and vendors — great for your accountant.
hub.step4Body: One Excel file with all reports and details. Optional: add your tax ID and notes in settings first.
hub.packBody: Includes profit & loss, balance sheet, year summary, monthly chart, sales & purchase lists

disclaimer.title: Friendly reminder
disclaimer.body: This tool organizes your business numbers to make tax time easier. It does not file taxes for you — share these summaries with your accountant or tax preparer when you are ready.

banner.title: Preparing taxes for this period
banner.hint: Reports use completed sales and purchases in these dates. Pending items are listed separately on the year summary.

pl.title: Money in vs money out
pl.subtitle: Think of this as: what did the business earn, and what did it spend, during your selected period?
pl.explainBody: Money in comes from completed sales (plus anything you added manually). Money out comes from completed purchases (plus manual expenses). The bottom line is a rough profit — hand this to your accountant rather than using it to file taxes yourself.

ys.title: Year summary
ys.subtitle: The big picture — how many invoices, payments, and returns you had, plus trends by month.
ys.explainTitle: Why share this with your accountant?
ys.explainBody: It saves them time. They get totals, monthly patterns, and your top customers and vendors in one view, alongside the detailed profit and balance reports.
ys.monthHint: Green-ish numbers are good — more in than out.
ys.noData: No data in this period yet.

bs.title: What you own & what you owe
bs.subtitle: A snapshot of the business today — customer balances, stock on hand, and unpaid vendor bills.
bs.explainBody: This is a simplified balance sheet. “What you have” includes money customers owe you and inventory. “What you owe” is outstanding vendor bills plus anything you added manually (like a loan).

manual.nameRequired: Give this entry a short name.
manual.addMissingHint: Not everything shows up in sales or purchases — add cash, loans, or one-off items here. Your reports update instantly.
manual.empty: No extra entries yet — that is OK if Custoray has everything.

settingsPage.intro: Optional details for your export file — currency, tax ID, and notes for your accountant. Everything here is optional.
settingsPage.displayCurrencyHint: How amounts appear on your tax reports.
settingsPage.currencyHint: Pick the currency you use for bookkeeping.
settingsPage.businessDetailsHint: Printed on your Excel export for your accountant.
settingsPage.taxIdPlaceholder: e.g. EIN, NTN, VAT number — whatever applies to you
settingsPage.taxRate: Rough tax rate on sales (%) — optional
settingsPage.taxRateHint: Leave at 0 to hide the estimate. This is only a rough helper, not a filing calculation.
settingsPage.notesPlaceholder: Anything they should know — home office, large purchases, etc.
settingsPage.manualEntriesHint: Same as step 2 on the Tax Helper home — {{categories}}.
settingsPage.clearHint: Clear optional settings and manual entries.
settingsPage.resetBody: Your sales and purchase data in Custoray is not affected — only tax helper preferences and manual entries are cleared.

categories.extra_incomeHint: Money you received that is not recorded as a sale in Custoray
categories.extra_expenseHint: Money you spent that is not recorded as a purchase in Custoray
categories.other_assetHint: Equipment, deposits, or other value not shown in inventory
categories.other_liabilityHint: Loans or bills not tracked under vendors

rows.shareWithAccountant: Money in minus money out — share with your accountant
rows.taxEstimateNote: Based on the rate you entered in settings
rows.haveMinusOwe: What you have minus what you owe

reportFootnote: Completed transactions only. Pending and cancelled documents are excluded from revenue and expense totals but pending counts appear on the year summary.
